title: Snapshot
description: The words of one edition of a source at one locus, as read on one day. A snapshot is written once and not edited. If a new edition changes the words, that is a new snapshot; whether an edition is current is a status assertion, not part of the snapshot. Kit v1.3. CC0 1.0.

source.description: Identify the source by a composite key, not by a number alone: gazette numbers, for example, are reissued each year.

edition.description: Which edition was read, as the issuer names it, e.g. 'June 2025 edition'.

locus.description: Question, article, paragraph and printed page — not the page of an electronic file.

wording.description: The words as they appear in that edition, in the original language.

wording_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 wording. Lets a later reader confirm the words have not been edited since they were recorded.

read_on.description: The day the words were read. null when the day was not recorded — a gap to disclose, not to fill from memory.

translation.description: An English rendering, if any, and whose.
